'''Version 1.9.12''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on April 17th 2023.  It was 16.53 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>Fixes</u>====
*"Mobs with Griefing Task Blacklist" not working when parasites are looking for light sources
*"Biome Spawn Entity List" typo in the list
*[[:Category:Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent versions]] not spawning inside the [[Parasite Biome|parasite biome]]
*EntityWave missing lang name
*[[Heavy Bomber]] getting stuck in the floor
*[[Wraith]] getting stuck in the floor if it has a target
*[[Bogle]] getting stuck in the floor if it has a target
*[[Assimilated Ender Dragon|Assimilated Enderdragon]] getting stuck in the floor if it has a target
*Removed COTH effect texture that was not in use
*[[Overseer]] getting stuck in the floor if it has a target
*[[Light Bomber]] getting stuck in the floor if it has a target
*[[Primitive Yelloweye|Primitive]] and [[Adapted Yelloweye]] getting stuck in the floor if it has a target
*Sometimes Heavy Bomber not following target
*"[[Link]] Chance" typo in description
*"Incomplete Cap" will now kill the mob with [[COTH]] instead of spawning particles on them forever
*"[[Assimilated Enderman]] Ally Teleport Damage" not working for Assimilated Enderman Walking Head
*Minecraft Mob Spawner blocks not spawning parasites 
*[[:Category:Deterrent Parasites|Deterrent versions]] leaping on water
====<u>New</u>====
*[[Commands|Command]]:
**/srparasites parasites
***Will show you current number of parasites loaded and current parasite mob cap

*EntityWaveShock
**Will not follow you
**Bigger hitbox
**It will break blocks
**Will throw you into the air

====<u>Configuration</u>====
*Added [[Succor]] Category - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
*"Mob Cap" maximum value increased to 50000
*"Biome Spawn Entity List" Removed all [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated]] and [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] versions from the list
*"Damage Types BlackList Mobs" description not required was removed
*"Damage Types BlackList Items" description not required was removed
*"Damage Cap BlackList" option removed
*"Damage Types BlackList" option removed
*"Mobs Additional Weakness" option removed
*Reduced minecraft:speed amplifier by 1 to all Dispatchers effects
*"Block Limit For Biome Infestation" from 8 to 4
*"Block Limit For Beckon Infestation Cooldown" from 40 to 200
*"Block Limit For Biome Infestation Cooldown" from 40 to 200
*"Heavy Bomber Explotion Multiplier" from 3 to 6
New options:
*"Mob Cap Per Player" - "Each Player will increase the mob cap by this value." - SRParasites.cfg
*"[[Colony]] Parasite Values Biome" - "Set to false if you want parasites from the list to spawn in Parasite Biomes ignoring points required" - SRParasitesWorld.cfg
*"Damage Deterrent RS" - "Set to false if you don't want Deterrents to die if the RS chance is 0." - SRParasitesSystems.cfg
*"Damage Cap BlackList Mobs" - "Damage (Only Mobs) that will ignore damage cap" - SRParasites.cfg
*"Damage Cap BlackList Items" - "Damage (Only Items) that will ignore damage cap" - SRParasites.cfg
*"Damage Cap BlackList Else" - "Damage (Everything that is not Mob or Item) that will ignore damage cap" - SRParasites.cfg
*"Damage Additional Weakness Mobs" - "Additional weakness (Only Mobs) for the parasites." - SRParasites.cfg
*"Damage Additional Weakness Items" - "Additional weakness (Only Items) for the parasites." - SRParasites.cfg
*"Damage Additional Weakness Else" - "Additional weakness (Everything that is not Mob or Item) for the parasites." - SRParasites.cfg
*"Armor Damage Types BlackList Mobs" - "Damage (Only Mobs) that cannot be learned by the armor." - SRParasites.cfg
*"Armor Damage Types BlackList Else" - "Damage (Everything that is not Mob or Item) that cannot be learned by the armor." - SRParasites.cfg
*"Damage Types BlackList Mobs" - "Damage (Only Mobs) Types that cannot be learned by the parasites" - SRParasites.cfg
*"Damage Types BlackList Items" - "Damage (Only Items) Types that cannot be learned by the parasites" - SRParasites.cfg
*"Damage Types BlackList Else" - "Damage (Everything that is not Mob or Item) Types that cannot be learned by the parasites" - SRParasites.cfg
*"[[Stage I Dispatcher]] Total Active Mobs" - "Number of Seizers/Sentrys this Dispatcher can spawn." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
*"[[Stage II Dispatcher]] Total Active Mobs" - "Number of Seizers/Sentrys this Dispatcher can spawn." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
*"[[Stage III Dispatcher]] Total Active Mobs" - "Number of Seizers/Sentrys this Dispatcher can spawn." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
*"[[Stage IV Dispatcher]] Total Active Mobs" - "Number of Seizers/Sentrys this Dispatcher can spawn." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
*"[[Bogle]] needed Health" - "Health (1 = 100%) needed to go invisible." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
*"[[Wraith]] needed Health" - "Health (1 = 100%) needed to go invisible." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
====<u>General</u>====
*[[Parasitic Cyst|Cyst]] Blocks will not always make a sound when eating items (50%)
*The command /srpevolution getphase will now show you current parasite mob cap
*[[Dispatcher Nidus|Nidus]] block will not spawn Dispatchers if current evolution phase don't support Nexus versions and instead will add points
*The [[Quench]] will now clean infested blocks in the same way as a [[Parasite Biome#Biome Purifier|purifier block]] instead of doing it instantly
*Updated "parasite_evolution_phases" Category description
*Changed texture for Beckon spawn eggs
*Changed texture for Deterrent spawn eggs
*Added tooltip for the Quench
*Vacuous cysts Blocks will now turn into Air Blocks when they are floating
*Changed block texture for:
**Infested Stain
**Infested Rubble
**Infested Trunk
**Parasite Bush
**Parasite Trunk
====<u>Mobs</u>====
*[[Moving Flesh]] will now use "Version Adapted Follow Range" option value
*Changed Longarms Wave Attack, will not use the new EntityWaveShock
*[[Warden]] will now spawn EntityWaveShock entities
*[[Host]] will now spawn EntityWave entities
*[[Herd]] will now spawn EntityWave entities
*[[Bogle]] now has the INVISIBILITY effect - will lose it when it shoots/gets hurt/its life is low
*[[Wraith]] now has the INVISIBILITY effect - will lose it when it shoots/gets hurt/its life is low
*Host will now use the primitive follow range config value instead of the assimilated one
*[[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pures]] will not summon tentacles if the current pahse does not support Nexus versions
*[[Assimilated Enderman]] will not damage other Assimilated Enderman by teleporting 
*Succors spawned by Wraith/Bogle while invisible will gain invisibility for a short period of time
*The blast damage of the succor will now use the value of the damage attribute of the one who spawned it * 2
*Removed boss bar from the [[Haunter]]
*Changed the following Attributes:
**HEAVY_BOMBER_HEALTH from 150 to 420
**COLONY_CARRIER_HEALTH from 150 to 390
**COLONY_CARRIER_ATTACK_DAMAGE = 45
**BOGLE_HEALTH from 150 to 310
**BOGLE_ATTACK_DAMAGE = 70
**WRAITH_HEALTH from 150 to 310
**WRAITH_ATTACK_DAMAGE = 70
**HAUNTER_HEALTH from 150 to 360
**HAUNTER_ATTACK_DAMAGE = 110
